# Zafar Saleem

> Zafar Saleem is a freelance developer specializing in building high-performance microsites, SaaS websites, and landing pages using React.js, Next.js, and TypeScript.

## Core Expertise & Services
- **Frontend Development:** React.js, Next.js, TypeScript, JavaScript, HTML5, CSS3, Tailwind CSS.
- **Specializations:** Microsites, SaaS Websites, High-Performance Landing Pages.
- **Key Projects & Case Studies:**
  - Mudah Marketplace Case Study
  - Slimming World Health Case Study
  - E-Commerce & Marketplace Case Studies
  - Activity Tracker Component Case Study
  - Personal Portfolio & Custom Client Portfolios (e.g., Kritzer Portfolio)
